arStrings.szText: Primary Skill: Lunge forward and strike an enemy.

{c_important}Lunging Strike{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and Heals you for {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_16]){/c} when it damages a {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c} enemy.

{c_important}Lunging Strike{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_31 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and an additional {c_number}[SF_15 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage for each target you lunge through, up to {c_number}[(SF_31 + (SF_14*SF_15)) * 100|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Lunging Strike{/c} has increased range, damages all enemies in its path, and can lunge without a target.

{c_important}Lunging Strike{/c} now has a {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} second Cooldown.
{c_important}Lunging Strike{/c} forms a {c_important}Dust Devil{/c} that deals {c_number}{payload:DUST_DEVIL_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Lunging Strike{/c} generates {c_number}[{SF_8}]{/c} Fury for each enemy you lunge through.
{c_important}Lunging Strike{/c} heals you for {c_number}[{SF_10}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_10]){/c} the first time it hits an enemy.

{c_important}Lunging Strike{/c} grants {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} seconds when it Critically Strikes.

{c_important}Lunging Strike{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_12 *100|+%|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance.
